titleZh: Delta whole-house renovation cost 2026 — Ladner / Tsawwassen / North Delta prices
contentEn:
In 2026, a whole house renovation in Delta, BC costs between $50,000 for a cosmetic refresh and $300,000+ for a full structural renovation. The final cost depends on whether you are updating a single-family home in Ladner, a townhouse in Tsawwassen, or a property in North Delta — and whether the scope includes the kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, and exterior. Reno Stars has completed whole-house projects in Delta, using real completed-project budgets from our database.

What Drives Whole-House Renovation Cost in Delta in 2026

Delta presents specific cost factors that differ from Vancouver or Surrey:

  • Ladner and Tsawwassen character homes — Many homes in Ladner and the original Delta municipality were built in the 1960s–1980s. These homes often have good structural bones but outdated electrical (60-amp panels), original Poly-B plumbing, and layouts that do not match how families use space today. Budget for electrical panel upgrades ($4,000–$12,000) and potential plumbing re-piping when pricing a whole-house scope.
  • Tsawwassen and Boundary Bay newer construction — Tsawwassen and Boundary Bay have many homes built after 2000. These tend to have modern layouts and finishes but still need updates as they approach their 20-25 year mark. The scope here is often cosmetic refresh plus kitchen and bathroom updates rather than structural work.
  • North Delta and Annacis Island industrial proximity — Properties near Annacis Island and the North Delta industrial area may have unique lot configurations or older subdivision homes that require additional engineering consideration for additions or structural changes.
  • BC Building Code Part 9 compliance — All residential renovation work in Delta (within the Corporation of Delta) must comply with BC Building Code Part 9. Reno Stars handles all permit applications for Delta projects.
  • Trade availability — Delta sits between Surrey and Tsawwassen. Trade availability is generally good, though specialist trades (heritage restoration, custom millwork) may carry a premium compared to Surrey's larger trade pool.

Do You Need a Permit for a Whole-House Renovation in Delta?

In the Corporation of Delta, permits are required for:

  • Any structural changes (removing or modifying walls, adding openings in load-bearing walls)
  • Electrical panel upgrades or new circuits
  • Plumbing re-piping or fixture relocations
  • Any addition or new construction (including laneway houses)
  • Changes that alter the building's occupancy classification

Cosmetic renovations — painting, flooring replacement, cabinet refacing, and fixture replacement in the same locations — typically do not require a permit in Delta. Reno Stars manages all permit applications as part of our standard project delivery.

  • Mid-scope (kitchen + 2 bathrooms + flooring): 10–18 weeks
  • Full structural renovation: 4–8 months
  • Addition or laneway suite: 6–12 months

Frequently Asked Questions — Delta Whole-House Renovation

How much does a whole-house renovation cost in Delta, BC in 2026?

A whole-house renovation in Delta (Ladner, Tsawwassen, or North Delta) costs between $50,000 for a cosmetic refresh and $300,000+ for a full structural renovation in 2026. A mid-scope project updating the kitchen, two bathrooms, and all flooring typically runs $100,000–$200,000. All prices include labour, materials, permits where required, and our 3-year warranty.

Do I need a permit for a whole-house renovation in the Corporation of Delta?

You need a permit for any structural changes, electrical panel upgrades, plumbing re-piping, or new construction. Cosmetic updates — painting, flooring replacement, and cabinet refacing in the same locations — typically do not require a permit. Reno Stars manages all Delta permit applications as part of our standard project delivery.

What is the difference between a cosmetic refresh and a full structural renovation?

A cosmetic refresh ($50,000–$100,000) covers paint, flooring, lighting, and hardware updates without changing the home's layout. A full structural renovation ($200,000–$300,000+) involves removing or adding walls, changing the floor plan, upgrading the electrical panel and plumbing, and may include a new kitchen and bathrooms with layout changes.

How long does a whole-house renovation take in Delta?

A cosmetic refresh takes 4–10 weeks. A mid-scope project (new kitchen, two bathrooms, flooring throughout) takes 10–18 weeks. A full structural renovation with layout changes takes 4–8 months. An addition or laneway suite project takes 6–12 months including permit processing time.
